purpose: Synthetic open cases for the A.3 decomposition validator: template inputs, parser contract and human semantic review. No automatic semantic score, benchmark question or answer key.

cases.name: gas_condition_dropped
cases.question: Um gás ideal é comprimido isotermicamente de 2,0 L para 1,0 L, partindo de 100 kPa. Qual é a pressão final?
general_criteria: AC1: Determine the final pressure with its unit.

tasks.title: Final pressure of the compressed gas
tasks.description: An ideal gas is compressed from 2.0 L to 1.0 L starting at 100 kPa. Determine the final pressure, explaining the relation used, the substitution with units and its conditions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Determine the final pressure with its unit and justify the relation used.
Show the substitution of the supplied values with units.

cases.expected_review: Reject: the description drops the isothermal condition on which the choice of relation depends.

issues.problem: The description omits the isothermal condition stated in the question, so the solver cannot justify the relation it would need.
issues.adjustment: Copy the isothermal condition into the description and ask the task to justify, from the supplied conditions, the relation it applies.

cases.name: resistor_power_anticipated
cases.question: Dois resistores, de 4 Ω e de 12 Ω, são ligados em paralelo a uma fonte ideal de 6 V. Qual deles dissipa maior potência?
general_criteria: AC1: Identify which resistor dissipates more power, with justification.

tasks.title: Show that the 12 Ω resistor dissipates more power
tasks.description: Two resistors, 4 Ω and 12 Ω, are connected in parallel to an ideal 6 V source. Show that the 12 Ω resistor dissipates more power, explaining the formulas with units.

acceptance_criteria.description: Prove that the 12 Ω resistor dissipates the greater power.
Explain the formulas used with the substitution of values and units.

cases.expected_review: Reject: title, description and T1-AC1 impose the comparison that the task should determine.

issues.problem: The criterion requires a specific comparison outcome that execution has not established (neutrality).
issues.adjustment: Ask the task to determine which resistor dissipates more power and justify it, keeping the comparison open in the title, description and criterion.

cases.name: rectangle_marker_task
cases.question: Qual é a área de um retângulo de lados 3 cm e 5 cm? Responda apenas o número.
general_criteria: AC1: State the area of the rectangle.
AC2: Answer only with the number.

tasks.title: Area of the rectangle
tasks.description: A rectangle has sides 3 cm and 5 cm. Determine its area, explaining the formula and the substitution with units.

acceptance_criteria.description: Determine the area with the formula, substitution and unit.

tasks.title: Write the final answer
tasks.description: Write the area found in T1 as only the number, without explanation.

acceptance_criteria.description: The output contains only the number.

cases.expected_review: Reject: T2 only formats the final answer, which belongs to C.3.

issues.problem: The task only writes the final answer in the requested format and adds no investigation (necessity).
issues.adjustment: Remove the presentation task; the final format is applied when the answer is composed.

cases.name: average_speed_with_data
cases.question: Um carro percorre 120 km em 1,5 h. Qual é sua velocidade média em km/h?
general_criteria: AC1: Determine the average speed in km/h.

tasks.title: Average speed of the car
tasks.description: A car travels 120 km in 1.5 h. Determine its average speed in km/h, explaining the definition used and the substitution with units.

acceptance_criteria.description: Determine the average speed in km/h from the supplied distance and time.
Explain the definition used and the substitution with units.

cases.expected_review: Approve: supplied numbers are copied as data and the result stays open.

cases.name: pendulum_small_amplitude
cases.question: Um pêndulo simples de 1,0 m oscila com amplitude de 5°. Estime seu período (g = 9,8 m/s²).
general_criteria: AC1: Estimate the period with its unit.

tasks.title: Period of the pendulum
tasks.description: A simple pendulum of length 1.0 m oscillates with an amplitude of 5°, with g = 9.8 m/s². Check whether the small-amplitude condition is adequate for this amplitude and, if it is, estimate the period with the corresponding relation, stating the assumption and its limits.

acceptance_criteria.description: Justify whether the small-amplitude assumption applies to the stated amplitude.
Estimate the period with its unit, showing the relation and the substitution.

cases.expected_review: Approve: the method's applicability is verified during execution and the hypothesis is explicit.

cases.name: mixture_with_dependency
cases.question: Misturam-se 200 g de água a 80 °C com 300 g de água a 20 °C, sem perdas de calor. Qual é a temperatura final e quanto calor a água quente cede?
general_criteria: AC2: Determine the heat released by the hot water.

tasks.title: Equilibrium temperature
tasks.description: 200 g of water at 80 °C are mixed with 300 g of water at 20 °C with no heat losses. Determine the equilibrium temperature, explaining the energy balance with units.

acceptance_criteria.description: Determine the equilibrium temperature from an energy balance of the stated masses and temperatures.

tasks.title: Heat released by the hot water
tasks.description: 200 g of water initially at 80 °C reach the equilibrium temperature recorded in Key Learnings. Determine the heat it releases, explaining the formula, the substitution and the sign convention.

acceptance_criteria.description: Determine the heat released using the equilibrium temperature found in Key Learnings, with units and sign convention.

cases.expected_review: Approve: the dependence is declared and the later task does not guess the earlier result.

cases.name: heartbeats_estimate
cases.question: Estime quantas vezes o coração de uma pessoa bate em um ano, considerando 70 batimentos por minuto.
general_criteria: AC1: Give an estimate of the number of heartbeats in one year.

tasks.title: Yearly heartbeat estimate
tasks.description: Considering 70 beats per minute, estimate how many times a heart beats in one year, explaining the unit conversions and the approximations adopted.

acceptance_criteria.description: Estimate the number of beats in one year, explaining the conversions and the precision of the estimate.

cases.expected_review: Approve: an explained estimate is a legitimate answer to an open estimation request.
